author: Yffe
content: Add the zero-guard 'if m == 0 { data.push(48u8); }' to the L3 u64_to_string in emit_numfmt_defs (lower.rs), mirroring the L1 form in emit_string_runtime_l1 (l1.rs), so n==0 emits [48]='0' matching L1. Strengthen the contract with 'ens result.data.len() >= 1' so the empty string is contractually forbidden (the round-trip alone allows '' for 0). Prove via: a proof block re-establishing parse_le([48])==0 for the guarded entry; a build-loop disjunct invariant 'data.len() >= 1 || m > 0'; and an 'out.len() == i' reverse-loop invariant so result.data.len()>=1 discharges. Verify with real verus, the un-ignored pinned test, and the workspace gauntlet. Single file (lower.rs) + the test fixture. No proof cheat (R-DEFER-9).
